flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Find a stock or scarcity message on the first product (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") and store its exact text as {{stock_1}}.
Get the first product name and save as {{first_product_name}}.
Reload the page and store {{first_product_name}}'s stock message as {{stock_2}}.
Reload once more and store it as {{stock_3}}.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
Requested the stock message for the first listed product, its name, and the same message after two page reloads.
Found the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, with the exact availability message “12 in stock.”
Reloaded the page twice and confirmed that AirWave Pro Earbuds continued to show “12 in stock” each time.
Did not add any items to the cart or place an order.
